# MM-P3-L3-HP03 Maintenance manual - Machining hydraulic forging press #3

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-HP03

## Scope
This document covers preventative and corrective maintenance tasks for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) located in P3, line P3-L3. Tasks include inspection, fastener verification, hydraulic system verification, and functional checks. Refer to SB-1011 for safety bulletin and to SOP-P3-L3-02 and SOP-P3-L3-03 for lockout/tagout and routine operation steps.

## Tools
- Calibrated torque wrench capable of 1600 N·m.  
- Hydraulic pressure gauge compatible with system fittings.  
- Standard mechanic hand tools and lifting gear per SB-1011.  
- Personal protective equipment as specified in SB-1011.

## Procedure
1. Prepare unit for maintenance following SOP-P3-L3-02 for lockout/tagout and SOP-P3-L3-03 for safe handling.  
2. Visually inspect ram, cylinder body, hoses, and fittings for leaks, damage, or misalignment. Document findings.  
3. Verify and test hydraulic system pressure with the hydraulic pressure gauge. Confirm the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 295 bar. Do not exceed this limit during testing.  
4. Torque main ram fasteners: the main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Apply torque in the sequence per manufacturer flange pattern; use calibrated torque equipment.  
5. After adjustments, cycle the press at low pressure per SOP-P3-L3-03 to confirm proper motion and absence of leaks. Monitor system for abnormal noise or behavior.

## Acceptance criteria
- No hydraulic leaks present at cylinder, fittings, or hoses after cycling.  
- System pressure does not exceed the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 295 bar during normal operation and testing.  
- Main ram fasteners are torqued to the main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m, verified with calibration record.  
- All safety devices and interlocks operational per SB-1011 and SOP-P3-L3-02/SOP-P3-L3-03.
